title: Desktop Multi-Site progressive base-list loading
opportunity: The Browser Multi-Site view rendered the authoritative Site list before the Health summary, but the WPF Desktop view awaited the summary before populating its grid. A slow or unavailable summary could therefore make the Desktop page appear empty even when Site configuration was available.
implementation: Render initial Desktop SiteRow values immediately after GetSitesAsync returns, using the live Site data and no historical trend yet.
Show the explicit Thai progress message that the Site list is available while the Health trend summary is loading.
Retain the existing generation/cancellation guard, last-successful-summary fallback, retry action, and final trend re-render.
boundary: Authenticated WPF published-EXE smoke with a deliberately slow or unavailable summary endpoint
Real PostgreSQL summary latency and large-Site-count benchmark
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
